items.reason: The regimen rule counts antitumour drugs and radiotherapy; TTFields ('Device: Tumor Treating Fields') is a device and 'The device itself is not an agent' (manual §1.2), so it is not listed as a partner. regimen stays 'combination' either way.

note: D31-C2 lists drugs and radiotherapy only, so the device TTFields stays out of combination_partners; no change. Candidate status is not affected: lenvatinib and pembrolizumab are not paired with device-enabled delivery or activation, so device_dependent is false.
